title: Austin's Future: Convention Center & Airport
summary:
*   **Convention Center Feasibility:** Detailed reports were presented and discussed regarding the viability of developing a new convention center for the city.
*   **Convention Center Financials:** City leaders examined the economic and financial implications of the proposed convention center project.
*   **Airport Concession Policy:** Officials reviewed and debated updates to the policies governing businesses operating at the city's airport.

CONVENTION CENTER REPORT
Craig Skien, Coopers and Lybrand, reviewed the feasibility of a convention center in
Austin. Bill Newman, First Southwest, discussed the financial aspects of a convention
center for Austin. AIRPORT CONCESSION POLICY Tim Ward, Director of Aviation, discussed the
concession policy for the airport.
